response.courseDescription: 199 Human Motor Development Development and performance of human motor patterns; understanding of motor development; observation and analysis of foundations of movement.
response.coursePrerequisites: A minimum ALEKS math placement score of 40%, or MATH 103 with a C or better, or credit for or concurrent enrollment in MATH 105, 106, 108, 140, 171, 201, 202, STAT 205, STAT 212 or PSYCH 311.
